description: Two fresh three-voter clusters: serial control and overlapping forwarded reads. Tick only node 1 until elected, durably process bootstrap/configuration and election no-op in an in-memory LogDB, and drain replication. Node 2 forwards context A; node 3 forwards B. For overlap, hold A heartbeat traffic until B heartbeat traffic and replies drain, then drain A. All votes, replication, read requests and replies are generated by actual Peer code. Observe every exported ReadyToRead at its recipient and preserve complete wire diagnostics. Stop after finite queues drain, independent of outcome.

harness.description: TestAssuranceReadContext uses Peer.Launch/Tick/ReadIndex/Handle/GetUpdate/Commit and the captured TestLogDB helper. Each origin issues exactly one read in each scenario.
semantic_changes: Use captured in-memory TestLogDB instead of engine LogDB and deterministic delivery queues instead of transport. No crashes or storage failures occur.
Driver persists State and EntriesToSave before any message delivery, applies bootstrap config/no-op entries, acknowledges Update and reports applied index.
Private state is read only for prefix/admission diagnostics; all protocol state changes use Peer methods.

legality.derivation: The captured Update contract requires State and entries saved before non-replication dispatch. harvest does so, uses only committed configurations/no-ops for simulated application, commits exported work, and passes actual applied progress. Launch generates bootstrap and Tick generates election; no support message is synthesized. ReadIndex accepts an explicit SystemCtx, so distinct nonzero constants substitute node-generated contexts without altering identity semantics. Finite message delay is the only network adaptation. A single request per origin makes response attribution independent of the compared context.
legality.applicability: Crash-free internal Peer boundary, no membership change after bootstrap, no application payload, one stable leader term.

grounding.derivation: Compare observed ReadyToRead.SystemCtx against the recorded admitted SystemCtx, correlated by scenario and origin node, which has exactly one operation in that scenario. Both Low and High are represented losslessly as a decimal pair. Read index is observed but deliberately not asserted equal.
grounding.applicability: Actual emitted readiness after the registered forwarded operation in a fixed-membership stable-term history.

observable_properties.description: Each emitted ReadyToRead at the sole read origin in a scenario preserves that admitted operation context.

uncertainties: This observes the actual Peer readiness output, not client RequestState completion or application read data.
The serial control and overlap histories establish no crash recovery or membership-transition result.
No success deadline is asserted; a missing result remains incomplete rather than proving infinite stalling.
